items.excerpt: UAD's free Luna DAW hits 3.0 with Luna Play for fast idea sketching, a proper piano roll and better MIDI editing. New smart features add automatic instrument detection, tempo recognition, stem separation, lyric transcription, chord extraction and audio-to-MIDI.

Roland released Melody Flip, a free AI-assisted songwriting plugin built with Sony Computer Science Laboratories. It generates melody variations from 250+ genre 'Palettes' and can analyse a reference track to suggest matching palettes, exporting ideas as MIDI.
TagoPitch is a free vocal pitch and formant shifter for macOS and Windows, giving bedroom producers independent control over pitch and timbre for vocal design without a paid suite.

Brian May explains why he reversed his position on AI in music: "We have to resist. We have to control it very, very seriously and very quickly." It is also why he has cooled on the idea of a Queen avatar show.

Roger Taylor says a Queen avatar show is "sort of" on the table, putting the ABBA Voyage-style digital-performer format — and the synthetic-likeness questions it raises — back in play for legacy acts.

BandLab's automatic mastering now offers preset intensity across 11 levels plus four member-exclusive presets designed with Grammy-winning engineers, and a three-band mastering EQ for Max subscribers.
Antares AutoTune Go arrives inside FL Studio through the free tier of FL Cloud, putting the industry-standard pitch-correction sound in front of every FL user at no cost.
Image-Line and Antares reveal AutoTune Go, a free pitch-correction plugin delivered via the free tier of FL Cloud so the iconic AutoTune sound is available directly inside FL Studio.
MOTU's Digital Performer 12 lands with deep Dolby Atmos support, an Arrangement Strip and AI-powered stem separation, modernising a long-running Mac and Windows DAW.

Suno v6 ships three new AI music models built alongside Warner Music and BMG, adding section-level editing, mashups, sampling tools and lyric-line edits that shift the platform from prompt-and-pray toward producer control.
zplane Timbre is a new multiband formant shaper with vocoder functionality and an Unlinked Mode, aimed at real-time vocal and sound-design transformation.
Dreamtonics' Instrument X swaps samples for neural synthesis to model orchestral instruments in real time. Production Expert tests what that means for template size, CPU load and sound.
Immersive Master Pro 1.5 adds IAMF and Eclipsa Audio to a tool used on nearly every Atmos delivery; batch encoding and MP4 export get put through their paces.
NUGEN Audio, RTW, Steinberg and Telos Alliance agreed a common DIU scale for dialog intelligibility measurement with Fraunhofer IDMT at IBC 2026, giving mixers one shared number to target.
While AI investment transforms recorded music, the argument here is that its biggest untapped use is operational: helping live-event professionals manage bookings, payments and workflows.
Believe and TuneCore say they won't feed artists' music to Suno without consent, with CEO Denis Ladegaillerie detailing a two-stage opt-in process for artists who do and don't want to participate.
Suno unveiled its v6 upgrade developed with "music industry partners" including Warner and BMG, even as it keeps fighting other rightsholders in court over training data.
